title: The Quiet Asset
author: Wren Winterbourne
blurb: Jude Quintana, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
